notes: Four new features: a Health check page (and `powerx doctor`) that scans everything PowerX already knows how to check and lists what's worth doing, most impactful first; startup entries whose target program no longer exists are now flagged and removable in one click; a plain-language "what is this" note for common processes in the Process inspector; and a CSV export button on the Drivers, Firewall, Scheduled tasks and Event log pages.
